stageNotes: Stage 1: apex returns 200 cleanly; www 301-redirects to apex. Canonical = https://wolverinesupplies.com (apex).

Stage 2: 8-batch heavy probe. All real-path responses 200; cf-ray header every batch; /wp-admin /.env etc return 403 because BC origin has no WP routes (not WAF). hasWaf=false; wafType=cloudflare-passive (informational).
Stage 3: cdn11.bigcommerce.com + x-bc-store-id:1003335859 + stencil/ paths + BC-Ray header => platform=bigcommerce-stencil. adapterType=generic-retail. No GraphQL token exposed.

Stage 4: homepage nav surfaced 12 firearm-relevant top-level paths. Two more (FIREARMS-ACCESSORIES, AIRGUNSM) found via /shop-all/ walk and confirmed via /xmlsitemap.php?type=categories. Walked all 14 at limit=1000, dedup by data-product-id. 14-cat union=5,683 dominates /shop-all/=5,567. Sitemap=8,169 (OOS-inclusive).
Stage 4g: 3 random firearms-page products fetched as detail pages — all returned title, price, in-stock status, valid URL. extractionTested=true.
Stage 5: ?page=N pagination zero-overlap p1 vs p2 on /firearms/: 0 shared IDs. perPage default=100. Verified ?limit=2500 also honored but shipping perPage=100.

Stage 6: <select name="sort"> options: featured (default), newest, bestselling, alphaasc, alphadesc, avgcustomerreview, priceasc, pricedesc. 3-outcome counter-control: default=newest (9026,9016,9013); newest sort matches; alphaasc returns 544,545,941. Verdict=honored-default-is-newest. sortParam=?sort=newest, sortVerified=true.
Stage 7: sort verified honored + product IDs monotonic auto-increment ascending => navigate-from-watermark.
Stage 8: /xmlsitemap.php?type=products&page=1 returned 8,169 <loc> entries (single-file sitemap; ?page=2 = 404). Drift vs walked-in-stock (5,683) = 30.4%, accepted per BC Stencil OOS-hidden quirk.
